shared_elements: low-relief figures rendered in profile silhouette
band or register of repeated linear marks
composition filling the whole surface with multiple motifs
justification: Both surfaces carry crowded low-relief compositions that combine animal figures in profile with a spreading frond- or plant-like motif and at least one band of repeated linear marks, but these correspondences are generic rather than specific. A is dominated by fluid curvilinear scrollwork and interlaced anthropomorphic figures with plumed headdress-like fans, while B presents discrete, isolated animal silhouettes (quadrupeds under arches, a long-necked bird, predators) stacked in separate registers with no scrollwork or human figures — quite different conventions and subject matter.
